$schema: Cross-language test vectors for the SDK's JSON canonicalizer.
description: Rule: decode the JSON, recursively sort object keys by byte/codepoint order (SORT_STRING-equivalent; arrays/lists keep their original element order), then re-encode compactly — no inserted whitespace, forward slashes and non-ASCII characters left unescaped. Every language SDK's canonicalizer must produce exactly `expectedOutput` (byte-for-byte) for every string in `input`/`inputs`.

format.escaping: forward slashes and non-ASCII characters NOT escaped (equivalent to PHP's JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)

cases.description: Object key order does not affect output
Insignificant whitespace does not affect output
Array element order is preserved (ascending case)
Array element order is preserved (descending case, must differ from the ascending case's output)
Keys of nested objects are sorted too
Keys within each object of an array are sorted independently
Order of objects within an array is preserved
Order of objects within an array is preserved (reversed case, must differ from the -a case's output)
Empty arrays round-trip as empty arrays
Object keys are sorted at every nesting level while arrays anywhere in the tree keep their order
Different content must produce different output (case a)
Different content must produce different output (case b, must differ from case a's output)
Malformed JSON must raise an error, not silently canonicalize
